scope: independent re-verification of the worker's D2-D5 and the G4 gate after the 17:18-17:30Z premature training segment
method: read the worker artifacts, then re-run the decisive experiments on the pod (aligned replay, near-dup audit, alignment regression, fresh expert rollout)

identity.recovery_evidence: metadata frame multiset for the 96 2x10 entries (seeds 80000-80131, controller cookie_2x10_variable_grasp, success=true) is identical, in order, to parquet episodes 749-844; the entries were only mis-indexed as 0-95
identity.policy: 96 2x10 stay frozen test-only (task class tagged); training split unchanged at 589 2x5

alignment.checks: label row offsets contiguous, frame boundaries match parquet, global dp diff 0.0, global gripper mismatch 0, recompute 7.7e-10
alignment.video: front video (to-from)*20 == episode frames for all 845 (new check, 0 mismatches)
alignment.note: 7D label rows are n-1 per episode by construction (deltas), so label row offsets differ from frame offsets by episode index; this is intentional and verified, not the old ep_start=[0,1,2,3] bug

dedup_near_duplicate.limitation: all 749 layouts live in a ~1 cm jitter envelope of one basic-profile scene; no lighting/material/friction/extrinsics variation. Test layouts are unseen combinations but not a new distribution. Documented, not a blocker for the 21k run on the same envelope.

D3_force.aligned_replay: even with the recorded seed/options the scene was still 2 cm/11 cm off (env/config drift), so replay forces remain 13-17x; open-loop replay is not a valid force comparison
D3_force.fresh_expert_probe: current-sim closed-loop same_column expert, seed 90000: 10/10 cookies in target by step 500, held through 1400+, L pad max 1.45 N
D3_force.conclusion: dataset force scale and current-sim successful-task force scale agree (~1.4-1.5 N); the 15-19x gap is a replay artifact, not a data problem
D3_force.ood_data_generation: not required for scale; the generation pipeline (collect_cookie_benchmark_cli / same_column expert) is available if later coverage needs it
D3_force.normalizer: train-only V2 stats valid; keep OOD/saturation reporting at eval as a monitor, not a data-acceptance caveat
